world: World: Rainward 13, a drowned city ward in heavy rain at night; wet dark asphalt and concrete; dark teal-grey colours with a faint dull red tint.
ground: wet dark grey asphalt seen close up: fine even grain of small stones in tar, many tiny shallow rain ripples and small wet patches, a few hairline cracks; NO big puddles, NO light reflections, NO curbs, NO road markings, NO manholes.
low: shallow dark teal water over sunken asphalt seen from above: many small evenly spread rain ripple rings on the water, faint grit visible below the surface; NO reflections of lights or sky, NO curbs, NO edges, NO objects; darker than the street around it.
high: a raised concrete sidewalk seen close up: lighter grey concrete in small square paving slabs (each about a sixteenth of the image wide) with thin dark joints, a light wet sheen and small stains, evenly lit; NO red or coloured light, NO puddles.
trail: a worn concrete road surface: medium grey concrete with fine grit, small chips, faint tyre scuffs and a light wet sheen, evenly lit; NO puddles, NO red, NO lines or markings.
cliff: a concrete retaining wall: a concrete curb edge along the top; below it, stained grey concrete with rust streaks, small drain holes and thin trickles of water.
